title: Graph neural networks for sampling-invariant embeddings of organized signal sets
abstract: arXiv:2609.35934v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sensor networks and radars can deliver signals as organized sets, e.g. ordered signals, signals describing range cells within a grid or signals perceived as graph nodes. Within such sets, individual signals may be characterized by distinct sampling parameters. This paper investigates organized signal sets neural network encoders. In the context of this work, the purpose of such encoders is to project heterogeneously sampled signal sets into an arbitrary fixed-size vectors space. This new representation space is designed so that signal sets can be processed as vectors rid of sampling differences to allow for arbitrary topology-aware processing with no signal processing constraints. Within this representation space designed to reduce the influence of heterogeneous sampling parameters, the relevance of signal sets representations is evaluated by considering signal sets discrimination potential with a focus on waveforms separation. translated_title: 用于有组织信号集采样不变嵌入的图神经网络
translated_abstract: 传感器网络和雷达可以以有组织集合的形式提供信号，例如有序信号、描述网格内距离单元的信号，或被视为图节点的信号。在此类集合中，单个信号可能具有不同的采样参数。本文研究了针对有组织信号集的神经网络编码器。在这项工作中，此类编码器的目的是将异构采样的信号集投影到任意固定大小的向量空间中。这个新的表示空间经过设计，使信号集可以作为向量进行处理而不受采样差异的影响，从而允许进行任意的拓扑感知处理，且没有信号处理约束。在这个旨在降低异构采样参数影响的表示空间中，通过考察信号集的判别潜力来评估信号集表示的有效性，重点关注波形分离。
tldr: 本文提出基于图神经网络的编码器，将具有异构采样参数的有组织信号集（如有序信号、距离单元、图节点）映射为固定大小的采样不变向量表示，从而支持无信号处理约束的拓扑感知处理，并通过波形分离等判别任务评估了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes graph neural network encoders that map organized signal sets with heterogeneous sampling parameters (e.g., ordered signals, range cells, graph nodes) into fixed-size, sampling-invariant vector representations, enabling topology-aware processing without signal processing constraints, with effectiveness evaluated through discrimination tasks such as waveform separation.
